title: Gridiron Standard evidence-backed re-rank research — MIKE/WILL/SAM/CB/FS/SS/K/P/LS

season_policy.primary_reason: Latest completed NFL season. Live 2026 stats through early November are incomplete and not available consistently across all players/sources; mixing would silently bias ranks.
season_policy.secondary_noted_but_not_ranked_on: Partial 2026 grades in local BG dossiers (projection context only).

methodology: Include every locked top10 + first_out + external_controls from baselines.
Emphasize verified 2025 public performance (PFF overall where public, PFR/nfl.com/nflverse counting stats, FG%/EPA, punt net/gross/I20, FKS LS unit points).
Weight sample size, role, injury, and style — not team record or reputation.
Preserve Official Page MADDEN variable values as existing GS judgments (not EA).
Do not alter canonical cards, baselines, or Pages.
Add omitted candidates only with sourced qualification.

gs_attrs_note: gs_full_card_attrs_preserved fields are Gridiron Standard judgments from the Official Page MADDEN variable / PHI_FULL — not EA Madden ratings. Absent attrs = not stored on Page for that player.
gaps: PFF position-specific sub-grades (coverage/RD/tackling splits) largely paywalled; public article figures cited where available.
No public tracking/speed for most defenders — movement traits on GS cards remain LOW confidence.
No public PFF long-snapper table; LS ranks use FootballKickingStats unit points (whole-unit credit) + bad-snap parses — THIN DATA.
No public punt hang time; PFF P vs net average can disagree (Stout).
Some 2025 team vs 2026 GS team mismatches after free agency — noted per player.
Local BG PFF overall sometimes differs by ~0.1–1.5 from public recap articles; both cited where material (e.g., Pierre 84.9 board vs 86.2 article).
Arvell Reese, Sonny Styles, Tyler Bass (2025), and some rookies lack usable 2025 evidence.
Cooper DeJean is SS-locked in GS but 2025 public grading is primarily as CB/slot — cross-position uncertainty.
canonical_status: RESEARCH ONLY — no baseline lock changes, no card edits, no Page edits performed.
